The image shows a leaf with distinct white, circular, and irregular patches of fungal growth on its surface. This powdery or dusty appearance is characteristic of Powdery Mildew. The symptoms do not match the descriptions for Anthracnose (black spots), Die_Back (browning, scorched leaves, twig death), or Sooty_Mould (dark, sooty deposits). The white, superficial mycelial growth is a classic sign of Powdery Mildew.
